{{Top|leg}}
'''Variant''', also known as '''Rift Mutation''', was a [[Bacteria/Legends|bacterial]] mutation in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. Due to exposure to the elements within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], the mutation spoiled [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] stores, leaving [[Starship/Legends|ships]] without a food source unless remedied. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vin Emil]], a [[xenobotanist]] at the [[Q'Maere Research Facility]], developed an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] for the mutation known as [[Variant Alpha]].
